main.description: Mint a child did:etzhayyim under a parent DID. ADR-0029 (revised 2026-04-19) defines two input shapes: (A) semantic path form — `{parentDid, segmentKind, segmentValue}`; (B) legacy hex Merkle form — `{parentDid, materialKind, material}`. New callers should use form (A). `pubkey` kind generates an independent P-256 keypair; other kinds are keyless and sign via the nearest ancestor key. Caller must control parent (session accountDid equal to parent or a prefix ancestor).

parentDid.description: Parent did:etzhayyim. Either legacy flat hex form (did:etzhayyim:{24-hex}) or semantic path form (did:etzhayyim:{sub}:{id}:{lexicon}). Recursive form accepted up to depth 6.

segmentKind.description: ADR-0029 revised (semantic path) form. `sub`: owning cluster label. `id`: local identifier (TID / slug / rkey). `lexicon`: governing NSID. `role`: capability sub-identity. `pubkey`: generate new P-256 key. `grant`: consent / delegate. Mutually exclusive with `materialKind`.

segmentValue.description: Semantic segment value (NSID-compatible). Regex: [a-z][a-z0-9-]*(?:\.[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)*. Required when segmentKind is set.

materialKind.description: ADR-0029 草案 (hex Merkle) form — legacy Phase 1 grandfather path. Kept for existing adopters until they migrate to segmentKind/segmentValue. `pubkey`: generate new P-256 key. `role`: capability DID (requires roleName + holderDid). `matter`: domain entity (requires matterTid). `doc`: content-addressed document (requires docCid). `grant`: consent/delegate (requires granteeDid + grantExpiresAt + grantNonceHex). `session`: one-shot scoped capability (requires parentSessionJti + sessionNonceHex).

material.description: Kind-specific material for legacy materialKind form. Required keys depend on materialKind.

handle.description: Optional handle to attach (typically only for pubkey kind).

did.description: Newly minted child did:etzhayyim (full recursive form).

segmentKind.description: Echo of input segmentKind (semantic form only).

segmentValue.description: Echo of input segmentValue (semantic form only).

materialKind.description: Echo of input materialKind (legacy hex form only).

materialHashProof.description: Hex-encoded materialBytes (legacy hex form only). Verifiers recompute the child hash from this.

errors.name: InvalidMaterial
errors.description: Neither (segmentKind+segmentValue) nor (materialKind+material) supplied, or kind-specific field missing.

errors.name: ParentRevoked
errors.description: Parent or ancestor DID has revoked_at set.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: Caller's session accountDid does not control parentDid.

errors.name: ConfigError
errors.description: Server KEK or KEYS_DB not configured.
